card.title: I, Like, Music
card.tagline: Apprenez à exprimer quelque chose que vous aimez.

song.title: I Like Music
song.description: Une chanson douce pour mémoriser l'expression de ses goûts.
lyrics: I like, I like, I like music,
Soft notes falling like the rain.
I like, I like, I like music,
A gentle tune, a quiet song,
I like music all night long.
I like, I like, it makes me smile,
Music stays with me a while.
I like, I like, I like music,
Soft notes falling like the rain.
I like, I like, I like music,
